chapters.title: Pearl Harbor and enlisting
chapters.note: The Sunday on the radio, and why he picked the paratroopers.

chapters.title: Currahee
chapters.note: Camp Toccoa with Easy Company: three miles up, three miles down, every day.

chapters.title: Waiting in England
chapters.note: Nine days on a crowded boat, then eight months of English mud.

chapters.title: Normandy
chapters.note: The jump in the dark, the guns above Utah Beach, and Bill at Carentan.

chapters.title: Holland
chapters.note: A daylight jump, and the Dutch running out with bread and flowers.

chapters.title: Bastogne and Foy
chapters.note: Surrounded and freezing at Bastogne, then Foy across open snow. The forest never left him.

chapters.title: What he carried
chapters.note: A son held in the same hands, and the wings on the nightstand at the end.
